verdict.rationale: Collecting user feedback through a crash-report dialog or feedback widget is a fair question for an error-tracking product like Rollbar, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of a feedback widget or crash dialog. Person tracking, which shows which users an error affected, and Session Replay are related but different features, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can collect user feedback — a crash-report dialog or feedback widget — attached to the exact error event the user hit
